agent_notes: The English spelling 'Ajeetwana' returns almost nothing directly; the census/administrative spelling 'Ajeetmana' is far better attested (village code 069245, population 1,239 in Lunkaransar tehsil per two independent census mirrors). One Hindi Wikipedia user page gives a detailed founding legend under the spelling 'अजीतराणा' (likely a typo for अजीतवाणा/अजीतमाना) naming founder Ajeetaram of the Dhatarwal clan and listing sister villages (Kheenyera, Soolera, Bheekhnera, Kumbhana, Kolana) that match this unit's own 'nearby' list almost exactly - strong corroboration despite being user-generated c
